queries.query: "large language model" AND ("network configuration" OR "network-config") AND (generate OR synthesis OR "intent to config" OR "intent-to-configuration" OR "intent to configuration")
queries.rationale: Establish primary literature on LLMs producing network configurations or translating operator intent into configs (phenomenon and representative implementations).

queries.query: ("configuration repair" OR "config repair" OR "configuration debugging" OR "repair loop") AND (LLM OR "large language model" OR "transformer") AND (network OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Survey methods where generative models attempt to detect and repair erroneous configs, including iterative repair/patch workflows (mechanisms and mitigations).

queries.query: ("generate-validate-repair" OR "generate-then-validate" OR "verifier-assisted generation" OR "validator-assisted") AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (network OR NetOps OR "network configuration")
queries.rationale: Locate architectures that pair generation with formal/symbolic validators or runtime checks — critical for operational safety and guardrails.

queries.query: ("network configuration verification" OR "configuration verification" OR "reachability verification" OR Anteater OR Verifier) AND (SDN OR BGP OR OSPF OR policy)
queries.rationale: Collect deterministic/formal verification techniques and tools used to check network properties — possible validators for LLM outputs and benchmarks for correctness.

queries.query: ("bounded self-correction" OR "iterative self-correction" OR "LLM self-correction" OR "tool use" OR "chain-of-thought" WITH tools) AND (operational OR NetOps OR "network")
queries.rationale: Find papers examining controlled iterative correction or tool-augmented LLM workflows and their convergence/failure properties (mechanisms, safety envelopes).

queries.query: ("agentic" OR "autonomous agent" OR "agentic AI") AND ("network operations" OR NetOps OR AIOps OR "autonomous network") AND (safety OR trustworthiness OR reliability)
queries.rationale: Position agentic/autonomous-network management literature that discusses safety, control, and human oversight relevant to track constraints.

queries.query: ("AIOps" OR "AI for operations") AND (network OR NetOps) AND (survey OR benchmark OR evaluation OR dataset)
queries.rationale: Identify AIOps surveys, benchmarks, and datasets to assess existing evaluation practices and gaps in NetOps-specific benchmarking (benchmark validity).

queries.query: ("hallucination" OR "incorrect action" OR "erroneous command" OR "wrong configuration") AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (operation OR "network operations" OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Collect studies and incident analyses of LLM failure modes when performing operational actions to characterize practical failure patterns and risk.
source_preferences: incident reports, blog posts with reproducible artifacts

queries.query: ("tool-augmented" OR "tool assisted" OR "tool use" OR "APIs" OR "external tool") AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (network OR "network management" OR NMS OR CLI OR Ansible OR Netconf OR Nornir)
queries.rationale: Survey integrations between LLMs and existing network automation toolchains (practical mechanisms and mitigations via tool use).

queries.query: ("network emulator" OR Mininet OR GNS3 OR CORE OR "container network" OR "topology emulation") AND (evaluation OR testbed OR simulation) AND ("configuration validation" OR "policy testing")
queries.rationale: Find evaluation environments and simulators to validate generated configs safely and reproducibly (methods for experimental validation).

queries.query: ("benchmark" OR "evaluation benchmark" OR "dataset") AND ("intent-to-config" OR "network configuration" OR NetOps OR AIOps) AND (validity OR "construct validity" OR reproducibility)
queries.rationale: Target work critiquing or proposing benchmarks for LLMs/AIOps to assess construct/criterion validity and applicability to operational correctness.

queries.query: ("metrics" OR "evaluation metric" OR "operational correctness" OR "policy compliance" OR reachability OR safety) AND (network configuration OR NetOps OR "config validation")
queries.rationale: Gather proposed metrics (reachability, policy compliance, connectivity, security constraints) suitable for measuring operational correctness and their limitations.

queries.query: ("human-in-the-loop" OR "human oversight" OR "guardrails" OR "constrained generation" OR "access control") AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (operations OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Collect human-in-the-loop strategies, guardrails, and constrained-generation methods for mitigating operational risks when deploying generative agents.

queries.query: ("program synthesis" OR "intent synthesis" OR "synthesis" ) AND (network OR "network configuration" OR SDN OR P4) AND (evaluation OR correctness)
queries.rationale: Survey neighboring program-synthesis and intent-synthesis literature for algorithmic approaches and verification methods applicable to NetOps tasks (neighbouring work).

queries.query: ("reproducibility" OR "artifact" OR "replication" OR "open dataset") AND (NetOps OR "network configuration" OR AIOps OR benchmark)
queries.rationale: Identify reproducible datasets, shared artifacts, and open benchmarks to support experimental reproducibility and evidence verification.

inclusion_criteria: Primary peer-reviewed papers (IEEE, ACM, SIGCOMM/NSDI/OSDI, CAV/TACAS) and archival preprints (arXiv) with verifiable metadata
Benchmarks, datasets, and open-source tool repositories (GitHub, Zenodo) with accessible artifacts and usage documentation
Surveys and systematic reviews that summarize AIOps/LLM-for-operations literature
Papers or reports describing evaluation methods, simulators, or verification tools for network configuration correctness
Work discussing LLM failure modes, human-in-the-loop mitigation, or safety/guardrails in operational contexts
Public incident analyses or reproducible case studies where LLMs controlled or suggested operational actions
exclusion_criteria: Non-English literature without an English abstract or verifiable translation
Blog posts or opinion pieces that lack reproducible artifacts or primary references (unless they contain incident reports with reproducible evidence)
Proprietary/internal reports or datasets without public access or sufficient methodological detail
Papers prior to ~2000 unless clearly seminal to configuration verification mechanisms (include only when cited as foundational)
Works that only test generic language knowledge (QA/closed-book) without operational/NetOps task grounding
date_rationale: Prioritize literature from 2018–2026 because modern LLM-driven approaches and relevant tooling emerged after 2018; include 2010–2017 and earlier seminal works for formal network verification and automation foundations (e.g., Anteater, header-space analyses). For benchmarks and methods, prefer the most recent versions and follow-up critiques to capture current best practices and validity concerns.
